issues: Remove "fanfare" from keywords; Fanfare should be represented only as the ability timing, while Rush remains in keywords.

The fanfare should select another follower on the field and give this follower attack equal to that selected follower's attack; encode the chosen target explicitly instead of using buffDynamic with targetAttack and no target selector.
Remove "evolve" and "fanfare" from keywords; the evolve cost line belongs in evolveCost and Fanfare belongs as ability timing, not keywords.
The fanfare target is "an enemy leader or enemy follower"; change targets from enemyFieldCard to a selector/effect structure that can hit either the enemy leader or an enemy follower.
Remove "fanfare" from keywords; this card has only an activated [act][engage] ability and no Fanfare.

The fanfare should first select an enemy follower, then if there are at least 3 Hunter cards in your cemetery deal 2 damage to that selected follower; the current encoding makes the target exist only inside the conditional. Implement support for selecting a target before a conditional and reusing that selected target in a later effect.

The second clause is not this follower's onLeaveField ability. It should create a delayed effect on the enemy follower selected by the fanfare: when that follower is put from the field into the cemetery this turn, heal your leader by 2. Replace the current onLeaveField self trigger with a granted delayed trigger on the selected enemy follower; implement support for granting temporary "when this leaves the field to cemetery this turn" triggers to chosen targets.
Remove "evolve" and "fanfare" from keywords; the evolve cost line belongs in evolveCost and Fanfare belongs as ability timing, not keywords.

The fanfare says "Select up to 2 followers on your field"; do not encode it as dealDamageOtherFollowers to all other followers. It should target up to 2 followers you choose on your field, then if Overflow is active deal 1 damage to those selected followers. Implement support for targeting multiple chosen allied followers up to a maximum count.

The damage-triggered ability should be during your turn only and only when this follower takes ability damage. The current grantOnDamaged lacks the during-your-turn restriction and does not restrict the damage source to abilities. Encode those conditions correctly; implement support for onDamaged conditions such as controller turn only and ability-damage-only if needed.
